title: maki
brief: An AI coding agent (Rust, ratatui TUI) optimized for minimal context-token use: a tree-sitter `index` tool summarizes file structure before reading, system prompts stay concise, and subagents can pick weak/medium/strong models per task. It is extendable via neovim-like Lua plugins, supports skills/MCPs, session memory, and plan mode, and works as an agent backend for editors like Zed via ACP; MIT-licensed. Its benchmark claims are the author's own.
